test_glob_function: test the GLOB rule by creating files and verifying pattern matching output against expected results
test_glob_wildcard_patterns: test the GLOB rule with wildcard patterns like asterisk and question mark to match filenames
test_glob_character_classes: test the GLOB rule with bracket character class patterns to match specific character sets

test_glob_case_insensitive: test the GLOB rule on case-insensitive filesystems to verify path normalization behavior
